'''Park Holdings Inc.''', also known as '''PHI''', was a corporation that owned the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Knolstee]]. Park Holding Inc. used Knolstee as a layover for tourist who could stay in small and luxurious orbital stations that descended to the planet's surface. Once on the surface sightseers were welcome to take part in tours lead by Park Holdings mostly [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] staff.
